mechanism: Amikacin (aminoglycoside) causes nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity, while atazanavir is hepatically metabolized and renally cleared; concurrent use increases risk of renal dysfunction and reduced atazanavir levels.
action: Monitor renal function closely (baseline and periodic creatinine/BUN); consider alternative antibiotics if possible; if combination necessary, ensure adequate hydration and dose adjustment based on renal function.
